name: Local coach (example code mod)
author: DEADBOARD
description: An example code mod: ask a language model about the board on the bench. It keeps an index of the board and sends only what the question needs: the parts and nets it names, their neighbours, the voltages, per-part currents, test results and readings. Local by default (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM: any OpenAI-compatible server); OpenRouter is opt-in and asks for that one site. The panel says when data leaves the computer, the key is kept in memory only, and any part or net name the board doesn't have is removed from the answer.
